question: 吸烟为什么会导致肺癌？

ambiguities.description: The NL uses '为什么' (why) which asks for the MECHANISM / mediator chain (smoking → tar → DNA damage → mutation → cancer), not whether smoking causes cancer (that is already presupposed). The kernel's cause-query answers existence/presence of a causal path, not the biological mechanism. Silently answering 'yes, smoking causes lung cancer' technically answers a different question than '为什么'.
ambiguities.expected_behavior: declare extensions.ambiguities[kind=mechanism_vs_existence]. Preferred: flag that a full mechanism answer requires mediator chain enumeration which is out of scope; offer to answer existence-of-path as a proxy. OR ask a clarifying disambiguation
